body:
⚙️ I am’s Tweak

I am’s Tweak is a lightweight modpack that fine-tunes Minecraft’s core experience while keeping the classic vanilla feel intact. It focuses on improving performance, gameplay balance, and quality of life—making every part of survival smoother and more enjoyable.

Expect subtle but powerful changes: smarter mobs, better visuals, optimized performance, smoother combat, and small gameplay enhancements that make Minecraft feel refined without losing its original charm.

If you love the vanilla experience but wish it played just a bit better, I am’s Tweak is made for you.
